name: Malleus Cocconum: The Heiress
source:
You were Arenda Finch, a fifteen-year-old girl who had inherited a vast fortune. Expelled from your old school, you were transferred to a new school located within Dunkenwood House. The dark side of elitism awaited. Humanity or demonic nature? Love or desire? Your choices would determine her fate. 

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2965680/Malleus_Cocconum_The_Heiress/]Steam[/url]]
